remoteDesktop.reconnectingAfterLost: The connection dropped while the tab was hidden. Reconnecting...
remoteDesktop.connectionLost: The connection dropped and could not come back. Reconnect to try again.
remoteDesktop.clipboardWaiting: Text copied in the session. Click or press a key here to put it on your clipboard. Open Termix over HTTPS to copy right away.
remoteDesktop.guacdUnavailable: The external guacd is not answering. Check that it is running, or turn off Use an external guacd in the Remote Desktop settings.
remoteDesktop.credentialPromptDescription: This host is set to prompt for credentials on connect. They are used for this session only and are not saved.

files.title: Drive Files
files.uploadDisabled: Uploads are disabled for this connection
files.driveUnavailable: Enable RDP drive redirection before uploading files
files.driveNotWritable: Termix cannot write to the drive folder. Check RDP_DRIVE_PATH, or GUACD_DRIVE_PATH with an external guacd, and its permissions.

toolbar.switchToTrackpad: Switch to trackpad mode (drag to move cursor, tap to click)
toolbar.switchToTouch: Switch to touch mode (tap directly where you want to click)
toolbar.label: Remote desktop toolbar

hints.files: Shows once the RDP drive is on
hints.modifiers: Ctrl, Alt, Shift and the system key stay held until the next key
hints.logoff: Signs out of Windows by running logoff from the Run box. The session must be open and showing the desktop.
hints.record: Starts or stops a recording of this session. Needs the Session Recording plugin and the built-in engine.
hints.softKeyboard: Shows the on-screen keyboard on a phone or tablet

toolbar.logoffConfirm: Sign out of this Windows session? Unsaved work in it is lost.
toolbar.recordRequired: An admin made recording required on this host

remoteDesktop.disabled: Remote Desktop is turned off. An admin can turn it on in Settings.

rustdesk.videoUnsupported: This browser can not play RustDesk video. Use a recent Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
rustdesk.passwordDescription: The remote device needs a password. It is used for this session only and is not saved.
rustdesk.passwordWrong: That password was not accepted. Try again.
rustdesk.codeDescription: The remote device needs the code from its authenticator app.
rustdesk.codeWrong: That code was not accepted. Try again.

hosts.nativeRdpFailed: Failed to open Windows Remote Desktop

guac.authTypeNoneDesc: No credentials are stored. You'll be prompted for a username and password each time you connect; they are not saved.
guac.kdcUrlDesc: Domain controller for Kerberos sign in, for accounts in Protected Users. Needs the built-in engine, the host entered by its DNS name and the domain filled in. Leave empty for NTLM.
guac.loadBalanceInfoDesc: RD Connection Broker cookie for RDS farm load balancing (e.g. tsv://MS Terminal Services Plugin.1.CollectionName)
guac.guacdProxyDesc: Termix connects to this host itself. Only set a guacd server if this host should go through your own guacd instead. Leave blank to use the global setting.
guac.guacdAdminOnly: Only admins can change the guacd server for a host.
guac.guacdSaveHostFirst: Save the host first, then set its guacd server here.
guac.guacdSaveFailed: Failed to save the guacd server
guac.gatewayNote: RD Gateway needs an external guacd. Hosts with a gateway go to it when one is set up, in the Remote Desktop settings or under guacd Proxy.
guac.ignoreCertificateDesc: Allow connections to hosts with self-signed certificates
guac.forceLosslessDesc: Force lossless image encoding (higher quality, more bandwidth)
guac.disableAudioDesc: Mute all audio from the remote session
guac.enableAudioInputDesc: Forward local microphone to the remote session | Only with an external guacd
guac.menuAnimationsDesc: Enable menu fade and slide animations
guac.disableBitmapCachingDesc: Turn off bitmap cache (may help with glitches) | Only with an external guacd
guac.disableOffscreenCachingDesc: Turn off offscreen cache | Only with an external guacd
guac.disableGlyphCachingDesc: Turn off glyph cache | Only with an external guacd
guac.enableGfxDesc: Use RemoteFX graphics pipeline | Only with an external guacd
guac.enablePrintingDesc: Redirect local printers to the remote session
guac.enableDriveRedirectionDesc: Map a local folder as a drive in the remote session
guac.disableDownloadDesc: Prevent downloading files from the remote session
guac.disableUploadDesc: Prevent uploading files to the remote session
guac.enableTouchDesc: Enable touch input forwarding | Only with an external guacd
guac.consoleSessionDesc: Connect to the console (session 0) instead of a new session
guac.sendWolPacketDesc: Send a magic packet to wake this host before connecting
guac.disableCopyDesc: Prevent copying text from the remote session
guac.disablePasteDesc: Prevent pasting text into the remote session
guac.excludeOutputDesc: Do not record screen output (metadata only)
guac.includeKeystrokesDesc: Record raw keystrokes in addition to screen output
guac.swapRedBlueDesc: Swap the red and blue color channels (fixes some colour issues)
guac.readOnlyDesc: View the remote screen without sending any input
guac.fontNameDesc: Only with an external guacd. The built-in engine uses its own monospace font.
guac.ardLeaveBlank: Leave blank for a VNC-only password

hosts.userDefaultsNote: Settings you leave unchanged follow your host defaults.
hosts.connectionOriginNote: On the desktop app, RDP, VNC and Telnet run on this device when the host is left on Default, like SSH. Pick Remote server to run them on the server instead.
hosts.connectionOriginGuacamoleNote: RDP, VNC and Telnet run on this device by default, like SSH. Pick Remote server to run them on the server instead.

rustdesk.directDesc: Connect to the host address instead of looking up a RustDesk ID. Direct IP access must be on in RustDesk on that device.
rustdesk.directNote: The connection is encrypted, but with no ID server there is nothing to prove which device answered.
rustdesk.idDesc: The ID shown in RustDesk on the remote device.
rustdesk.passwordDesc: The permanent or one time password set in RustDesk. Leave it empty to have someone accept the session on the remote device.
rustdesk.serverDesc: Leave empty to use the server set in the Remote Desktop admin settings, or the public RustDesk server when none is set.
rustdesk.keyDesc: The public key of your RustDesk server, from id_ed25519.pub.

hosts.moonlightDescription: Low latency streaming from a Sunshine PC

moonlight.pcDesc: The Sunshine PC to stream. Moonlight Web lists every PC it knows.
moonlight.addPc: Add this host to Moonlight Web
moonlight.addPcDesc: Adds {{address}} on port {{port}}, shared with every Moonlight Web user.
moonlight.pairDesc: This PC has to be paired with Moonlight Web once.
moonlight.pinDesc: Open the Sunshine web UI on the PC, go to PIN, and enter this PIN.
moonlight.pairFailed: Pairing failed. Check the PIN and try again.
moonlight.noSetUpAccess: Ask an admin to add and pair this PC.
moonlight.appDesc: What to open on the PC.
moonlight.bitrateDesc: Leave at 0 to use the Moonlight Web default.
moonlight.fpsDesc: Leave at 0 to use the Moonlight Web default.
moonlight.transportDesc: WebRTC has the lowest delay. WebSockets work on networks that block it.
moonlight.notConfigured: An admin has to set up the Moonlight Web server in the Remote Desktop settings.
moonlight.signInNote: Moonlight Web asks you to sign in the first time.
moonlight.noH264: This browser can't play H.264 video. If the stream won't start, use Chrome, Edge or the Termix desktop app, or turn on HEVC or AV1 in Sunshine.
moonlight.errorRecordingRequired: Recording is required on this host, and Moonlight streams can't be recorded.
moonlight.errorNotLinked: No PC is linked. Pick one in the host editor.
moonlight.errorNotPaired: This PC is not paired yet. Pair it in the host editor.
moonlight.errorOffline: The PC is offline, or Sunshine is not running.
moonlight.errorNoApps: Sunshine has no apps to open on this PC.

onboarding.guacdIntro: Remote desktop is set to use your own guacd. Check that it answers, or point Termix at it.
onboarding.guacdMissingDesc: You can carry on and set it up later. Remote desktop sessions will not connect until it answers.
onboarding.guacdComposeTitle: Add it to your docker compose file
onboarding.guacdEnvNote: If GUACD_URL, GUACD_HOST or GUACD_PORT is set on the server, that wins over this.

colorDepth.label: Color Depth
colorDepth.description: Used for RDP hosts that leave it on their default.

resizeMethod.label: Resize Method
resizeMethod.description: How the remote screen follows the window size.

forceLossless.label: Force Lossless
forceLossless.description: Force lossless image encoding (higher quality, more bandwidth)

disableAudio.label: Disable Audio
disableAudio.description: Mute all audio from the remote session

enablePrinting.label: Enable Printing
enablePrinting.description: Redirect local printers to the remote session

enableDrive.label: Enable Drive Redirection
enableDrive.description: Map a local folder as a drive in the remote session

disableCopy.label: Disable Copy
disableCopy.description: Prevent copying text from the remote session

disablePaste.label: Disable Paste
disablePaste.description: Prevent pasting text into the remote session

enabled.label: Enable Remote Desktop
enabled.description: Allow RDP, VNC and Telnet connections.

useGuacd.label: Use an external guacd
useGuacd.description: Termix runs RDP, VNC and Telnet itself. Turn this on to send them to your own guacd instead. REMOTE_DESKTOP_ENGINE overrides this.

guacdUrl.label: guacd URL
guacdUrl.description: Where guacd listens, as host:port. The GUACD_URL, GUACD_HOST and GUACD_PORT environment variables override this.

rustdeskIdServer.label: RustDesk ID server
rustdeskIdServer.description: Your own RustDesk ID server (hbbs), as host or host:port. Leave empty to use the public RustDesk server. Hosts can set their own.

rustdeskRelayServer.label: RustDesk relay server
rustdeskRelayServer.description: Your RustDesk relay server (hbbr). Leave empty to use what the ID server says.

rustdeskKey.label: RustDesk server key
rustdeskKey.description: The public key of your RustDesk server, from id_ed25519.pub. Needed with your own server.

moonlightUrl.label: Moonlight Web address
moonlightUrl.description: The Moonlight Web server Termix talks to, for Sunshine streaming. See the docs to run one.

moonlightPublicUrl.label: Moonlight Web public address
moonlightPublicUrl.description: The address browsers open, if it differs from the one above. HTTPS is needed for gamepads and keyboard lock.

moonlightUsername.label: Moonlight Web username
moonlightUsername.description: An admin login on Moonlight Web. Termix uses it to list, add and pair PCs.

moonlightIgnoreCert.label: Ignore Moonlight Web certificate
moonlightIgnoreCert.description: Turn on for a self-signed certificate on Moonlight Web.

enableToolbar.label: Remote desktop toolbar
enableToolbar.description: Show the toolbar in RDP, VNC, ARD and Telnet sessions.

toolbarPosition.label: Toolbar position
toolbarPosition.description: Show the toolbar above or below the session.

toolbarLabels.label: Toolbar labels
toolbarLabels.description: Show names next to the icons, or icons only. Names hide on their own when space runs out.

toolbarButtons.label: Toolbar buttons
toolbarButtons.description: Pick which buttons show and in what order. Buttons that don't fit go in the More menu.

rdpAutoReconnect.label: Automatically reconnect RDP
rdpAutoReconnect.description: Reconnect when an RDP session is lost. Turn off to reconnect manually and avoid interrupting sessions opened from another client.

rdpAutoResize.label: Automatically resize RDP
rdpAutoResize.description: Adjust the remote resolution when the window changes size. Turn off to keep the size chosen at connection until reconnecting.

sessions.title: Share remote desktop sessions
sessions.description: Let session sharing and collab rooms show this user's RDP, VNC and Telnet sessions to others.

monitor.title: Watch everyone's remote desktop sessions
monitor.description: Lets other features, such as Session Recording, list, watch and end the RDP, VNC and Telnet sessions of every user.

moonlight.title: Set up Moonlight PCs
moonlight.description: Add Sunshine PCs to Moonlight Web and pair them, using the saved Moonlight Web login.

errors.remoteServerRequired: Remote server required. Connect a remote server in Settings to use this connection type.

plugin.name: Remote Desktop
plugin.description: RDP, VNC and Telnet sessions in your browser, with clipboard, file transfer, sharing and recording.
